new_authority.same_failure_rule: Two effective repairs on one route without new evidence/progress stop that route for root-cause analysis and independent reassessment. A materially different reviewed technical approach may proceed within remaining global budget; do not convert every such technical stop into a new human permission request.
new_authority.installed_model_selection: If a demonstrated compatibility/quality gap requires comparison, permit only already-installed local visual models, read-only identity/capability discovery and process-local selection. global_cumulative_limits.model_action_counting: Attempted inference sends and intentional model warm/load count including timeout/refusal/cancel/failure. Status/metadata/unload are not inference; bind finite request/operation/time budgets.
global_cumulative_limits.zero_model_startup: Preserve failed child and actual service/time usage; no effective-full charge if zero model send/load is proved. Never rewrite/refund historically consumed grants.
global_cumulative_limits.global_exhaustion: WAIT_BUDGET with a single exact global increment decision; do not lower acceptance or invent other Stage IDs to reset counters.

build_only_dependency_acquisition.scope: Only dependencies, portable Python/FFmpeg/frontend build/test tools actually required by the approved V1 lock/manifests and not usable from existing local cache. Read relevant official technical/license metadata.
build_only_dependency_acquisition.sources: The dependency official project, official package registry and its authenticated official distribution/CDN; record original source, exact version, digest and license before executing/building.
build_only_dependency_acquisition.isolation: Install/unpack only in this project build cache, isolated environment or portable-package staging roots; record receipts and rollback. No system/global pip/npm/apt installs, permanent PATH/registry/service/driver/CUDA/Comfy upgrades.
build_only_dependency_acquisition.runtime_network: Product inference and acceptance remain loopback/no-cloud; no runtime pip/npm install or auto-update. Never transmit media, credentials or private contents for dependency acquisition.

human_gates.machine_and_independent_review: Mandatory before human acceptance. Codex implementer cannot independently approve its own candidate.
human_gates.experience: Human examines real outputs and explicitly signs the exact completed scope; no advance substitute signature.
human_gates.release: Final V1 production publication still requires explicit release authorization.
human_gates.git: Retain existing ordinary commit/push immediately after actual Stage human acceptance. No force push, remote merge or publishing permission inferred.
